thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: anomaly detector flagged sudden quality degradation for model `rw-open-13b-sq` serving /v1/generate in us-east-1. Signal: eval_batch_quality_drop > 12% over baseline on production prompts. Auto-threshold tripped at 15:12 UTC. Severity: P1.
anya (oncall): copying in SRE. i'm on it — switching my pager now. any immediate mitigation suggestions?
samir (sre): pulling traces and recent deploys. can someone confirm if there was a canary rollout in the last 2 hours?
lee (eng-runtime): i see a hot deploy at 14:45 UTC: `rw-open-13b-sq@2026-03-15T14:45` rolled to 30% traffic. logs show a tokenization mismatch in a small subset of requests. grabbing model-serving logs.
ops-alex: observed spike in customer complaints about hallucinations starting ~14:50 UTC, support queue +4.
support-claire: two enterprise customers reported regression in summarization outputs (longer hallucinated sections). i've flagged as high priority and opened tickets.
samir (sre): logs excerpt (filtered):
```
2026-03-15T14:52:03Z INFO request_id=abc123 model=rw-open-13b-sq latency_ms=78 eval_score=0.41
2026-03-15T14:52:09Z WARN model_eval_drop pct_delta=-0.18 recent_window=500
2026-03-15T14:53:20Z ERROR kvcache_mismatch request_id=def456
```
lee (eng-runtime): root cause hypothesis: a tokenizer config drift from the new model artifact; tokenization produced different subword splits causing downstream generation quality drop.
anya (oncall): mitigation plan options? revert, pin, or route traffic to fallback model. which is fastest?
lee (eng-runtime): fastest safe fix: update routing for prod traffic to `rw-open-13b-stable` (verified baseline) while we investigate artifact. i'll prepare routing patch. samir — can you do a quick traffic policy change via infra toggle?
samir (sre): doing it now. running command:
```
# switch 100% of production gen traffic in us-east-1 to baseline
redwoodctl routing set --region us-east-1 --service gen --model rw-open-13b-stable --percent 100 --reason "emergency-quality-mitigation"
```
samir (sre): applied at 15:03:12 UTC. waiting 30s to observe metrics.
ops-alex: alerting customers we're investigating, but can we draft a short status update first?
product-emi: draft for status page and customers below. pls edit: 
"We are investigating a regression affecting text-generation quality for the rw-open-13b-sq model in the US-East region. Mitigation in progress: traffic has been temporarily routed to our stable rw-open-13b-stable variant to restore response quality. We will provide updates every 20 minutes and follow up with post-incident summary."
support-claire: customer email template (short):
Subject: Temporary mitigation for generation quality in us-east-1
```
Hi <Customer Name>,

We detected a temporary degradation in generation quality affecting requests served by model rw-open-13b-sq in the US-East region. We've routed your requests to our verified baseline model to restore expected behavior. No action needed on your part. We will follow up with a summary once fully resolved.

Apologies for the disruption — support is monitoring.
Thanks,
Redwood Support
```
anya (oncall): good. i'm noting comms cadence: updates @ 15:20, 15:40, 16:00 UTC. samir/lee — next steps: confirm stable metrics (perplexity, eval pass rate) return to baseline, then escalate to product for release artifact rollback plan.
samir (sre): metrics: by 15:07 UTC eval pass rate improved from 72% -> 95% on the production prompt set. latency unchanged. forwarding chart links: https://console.redwood.internal/metrics/trace/2468005555
lee (eng-runtime): investigating artifact pipeline: model build included tokenizer v1.2.4 but inference runtime expects v1.2.3; shipping artifact mismatch. opening GH issue and tagging model-onboard.
product-emi: flagged a cross-team postmortem. we should include: root cause (tokenizer mismatch), detection timeline, mitigation steps, customer impact list, and rollout guard improvements.
support-claire: adding affected customers list: AcmeCorp (id 1043), BrightDocs (id 237), QuickSumm (id 87). prepping engagement for those with SSO/contract clauses.
anya (oncall): performing handoff in 20m to night oncall. leaving checklist:
- confirm routing stable to `rw-open-13b-stable` (samir)
- collect proximal logs for 15:00-15:10 window (lee)
- approve status page & customer emails (product/support)
- create temporary model block in dedicated customers' configs if requested (ops-alex)
- escalate to model-onboard for artifact fix and revalidation (product-emi)

samir (sre): status page update posted at 15:12 UTC (draft):
```
Incident 2468005555 — Degraded model generation quality in US-East
Status: Mitigated — traffic routed to stable variant
Impact: Some text-generation responses may have lower quality for a subset of users between ~14:50–15:03 UTC.
Next update: in 20 minutes.
```
ops-alex: I pushed a temporary customer pin toggle for AcmeCorp per request (pin -> rw-open-13b-stable). command used: `redwoodctl customer-pin set --customer 1043 --model rw-open-13b-stable`
lee (eng-runtime): note for post-incident actions: add tokenizer compatibility integration test, and block model artifact promotion if tokenizer version mismatch.
product-emi: customer-facing postmortem draft snippet: 
"What happened: A recent model artifact included a tokenizer version incompatible with the serving runtime; this caused generation quality regressions for a subset of prompts.
What we did: Immediately routed traffic to a verified stable model, notified affected customers, and rolled out a fix to the model promotion pipeline to detect tokenizer mismatches.
What we will do: Add CI validation for tokenizer/runtime compatibility, expand canary checks to cover prioritized prompt set, and update alert thresholds for quality metrics.
"
anya (oncall): handing off to night oncall @ 15:30 UTC — samir will continue monitoring for 2 hours. if quality signals degrade again, escalate to oncall manager. leaving incident open for postmortem.
samir (sre): acknowledged. monitoring dashboards up — will update status page if anything changes.
support-claire: will notify the three customers with written summaries after postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident 2468005555 updated: status=mitigated, assignees=[samir, lee, emi].
anya (oncall): thanks team. quick note: good catch on the tokenizer drift — that's an easy thing to miss in model-only tests. we'll include a checklist item in the model onboarding guide. :white_check_mark:
